basic_info.description: See unit in person before requesting an application. Penthouse 7F is a spectacular trophy condo offering an unparalleled living experience w/breathtaking views of the iconic GGBridge from both living levels as well as the 690sqft private roof deck which is accessed from within the unit. Set in the heart of SF's vibrant Cow Hollow neighborhood, this contemporary floor plan has an open living/dining area with a walk out balcony with stunning views - perfect for entertaining. The gourmet kitchen is outfitted w/chic quartz countertops, 6-burner Bertazzoni gas range, Thermador fridge & an expansive breakfast bar. The private lower level has a well-scaled guest bdrm, w/chic full bath, custom CA closet & super luxe primary suite w/views, custom walk-in closet & spa-like bath w/double sink vanity, glass surround shower & soaking tub. Add'l features include high ceilings, in-unit laundry, 1 pkg + storage. Residents enjoy exclusive access to the welcoming lounge, a common roofdeck w/BBQs, fire pit & seating area. Located just steps from the bustling lifestyle of Union St & upper Polk cafes & shops, this spectacular penthouse is also close to Fort Mason, Marina Green & the St. Francis Yacht Club.
